text: Per the Matrice 4T manual, loss of the remote signal triggers a failsafe RTH if the Signal Lost Action is set to RTH; the aircraft will automatically initiate RTH and continue it even if the RC link returns. RTH can also be started by the user or due to low battery, using Advanced RTH as configured. Under suitable lighting, the RTH path may be shown before loss.
